title: Some Command Palette extensions remain running even after Powertoys is closed

judgment.rationale: The maintainer is waiting for the affected third-party extension names and versions. The latest author comment says the issue is not universal and that their currently tested extensions close; no PowerToys-side fix can be targeted until the remaining extension is identified.
evidence: The maintainer says some third-party extensions need to update to handle shutdown and asks which extensions and versions remain running.
The latest author comment says the issue is limited to some extensions and reports their locally tested extensions now close.
The latest issue comment explicitly asks for extension names and versions; the thread contains no subsequent answer identifying them.

The extension service signals disposal for running installed extensions during teardown.
